history.period: Modern (temple trust registered c. 2011; Sai Baba idol predates it, story unverified)
history.summary: A Sai Baba devotional shrine on Dumas Road (Opp. Airport, Piplod), 11 km from Surat city centre. A 2007 devotee blog records the idol near Valentine multiplex on Dumas Road, noting the site previously held the tomb of a Sufi mystic and that the idol was 'placed afterwards' - the story behind that has never been published (unverified). Justdial lists the temple's charitable trust as established in 2011. Festival list follows the standard Sai Baba calendar; temple-specific festival details are not published - verify locally.

name: Sri Shirdi Sai Baba Temple
town_description: Surat is a major city of Gujarat on the Tapti river, known as the Diamond City and Textile City of India, with a historic trading port and a large migrant workforce that sustains many devotional shrines.

travel.airport: Surat International Airport (~5 km; the temple stands opposite the airport on Dumas Road - verify)
travel.road: On Dumas Road, Piplod; reachable by car/auto from central Surat

visitor_information.best_time: October-March; mornings (6-7 AM) preferred per travel guides
